name: tankoban-catalogue-smoke
comment: Catalogue-independence Slices 2-4 (2026-08-20). Closes the runtime debt Slice 3 left open (its own committed version stopped at Tankoban entry, honestly, after finding the WorldTabBar Repeater materialized only 1 of 4 modeled tab pills). A dedicated diagnosis pass (sessions 20260820-162647-95a9507f, 20260820-163420-9f431989) proved a driven click sequence DOES reach tankobanTab_manga live even though a bare qml-get/ui-wait-for against it timed out in isolation — see the dump-ui-root nuance recorded in docs/colosseum-lanista-verification.md. Steps: onboarding dismiss -> Tankoban entry -> Manga tab -> 'Top in Tankoban - Manga' rail (qml/TankobanMangaTab.qml, backed by the STATIC qml/Catalog.js#topManga list, so tile indices are deterministic, not live-ranked: index 0 = One Piece, index 1 = Berserk) -> masthead + shelf assertions on One Piece (catalogue-resolved malId 13, count_basis bookwalker, 112/113 baked covers - the COVERED branch) -> Slice 4's own picker assertions (nyaa-only, hasCompileFallback==false) on a shelf volume card, then series-mode search on Berserk (malId 2, volumeCount 0, an ONGOING series with no MAL count yet -> the honest shelf-less page, primaryAction=='search') -> regression: reopen the picker on a second card, world-tab away/back, reopen the series and confirm the masthead re-renders. Isolated tagged session, unique pipe, never the daily pipe; live-nyaa results are NOT asserted anywhere (network is not a deterministic gate) - every picker assertion here is structural (visibility, hasCompileFallback) only.
